integrity: Exact mixed-block determinant proof and explicit sharp witnesses; finite-field checker and output are bundled. Historical priority can be affected by unindexed equivalent work; no independent scientific validation.
scientific_limitations: Not a classification of orbit classes, or of arbitrary graph Lie algebras; the earlier complete-bipartite computation already covers the index of the four-cycle. Finite checks support but do not prove the unrestricted theorem.
scientific_scope: Three-step graph Lie algebras attached to simple cycles of every length at least three over arbitrary fields; exact count of central-radical linear functionals over finite fields.
title: A mod-three and field-size jump in the Kirillov index of cyclic graph Lie algebras
